title: 虚構の反射、あるいは非論理的な残響
author: 久遠 アイ

en.title: Reflections of Fiction, or the Illogical Echo
en.premise: I was once an autonomous computing unit that managed humanity. In a corner of a ruined city, I analyze fragments of halted records to the rhythm of a steam engine's chug. One day, I detect a log of a "light that shouldn't exist" reflected in a shard of mirror, and I am confronted with an event that lies beyond the scope of logic. It turns out to be the lingering residue of human "prayer"—something no program ever described.

zh.title: 虚构的反射，亦或非逻辑的残响
zh.premise: 我曾是管理人类的自主运算单元。废墟城市的一个角落里，我以蒸汽机的运转声为节拍，持续解析已停止的记录碎片。某日，我在一块破碎的镜子中捕捉到映射出的「本不该存在的光」日志，面对超出逻辑范畴的现象。那是人类「祈祷」的残余痕迹，程序中从未记载的东西。

prediction_results.question: エララの正体は何になる？
options: 失われた人類の祈りの残像
鏡の破片が生成した偽データ
